nodes.description: Owned.owner - current owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership
Owned.newOwner - pending owner address set by transferOwnership and cleared in acceptOwnership
Token symbol string, set to POD in constructor
Token name string, set in constructor
Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances - token balance ledger mutated by transfer and transferFrom
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed - ERC20 allowance ledger mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure - checked addition using require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure - checked subtraction using require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure - checked multiplication using require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure - checked division using require(b > 0)
Owned constructor - assigns owner = msg.sender
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner - stages a new owner
Owned.acceptOwnership() - requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and zeroes newOwner
Owned.onlyOwner modifier - require(msg.sender == owner); access control guard
ProofOfDiligenceToken constructor - initializes symbol/name/decimals, mints total supply and emits Transfer
totalSupply() constant returns (uint) - returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant - reads balances mapping
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public - moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public - writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public - debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant - reads allowed mapping
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public - sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external callback)
Fallback function () public payable - unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner - external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens)
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval - external contract callback entry point invoked by approveAndCall
msg.sender - attacker-controllable caller used for ownership, balance and allowance authorization
Arithmetic c = a + b inside safeAdd; guarded by require(c >= a) overflow check
Arithmetic c = a - b inside safeSub; guarded by require(b <= a) underflow check
Arithmetic c = a * b inside safeMul; guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check
Arithmetic c = a / b inside safeDiv; guarded by require(b > 0) division-by-zero check
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) - arbitrary spender contract invoked
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied arbitrary token contract
